skills.name: Rational numbers: compare, order, absolute value
skills.key: Farther right on the number line is greater. |x| is the distance from 0 and is never negative.
tiers: compare two integers; find |n| for an integer
compare a fraction and a decimal with mixed signs; |x| for rationals
order 4-5 mixed rationals including negative mixed numbers
distance between two rationals as |a - b| in a context
skills.gen: T1: a,b in [-30,30], distinct. T2: one fraction (denominator 2..12) vs one decimal (1-2 places), signs mixed. T3: 4-5 values, at least two negative, one repeated magnitude with opposite signs. T4: two altitudes/temps, answer |a-b|.

errors.desc: thinks |x| flips the sign of every number

skills.skin: altitude above/below sea level, cockpit temperature, fuel offset readouts

skills.name: Adding integers
skills.key: Same signs: add the sizes and keep the sign. Different signs: subtract the sizes and keep the sign of the bigger one. A number plus its opposite is 0.
tiers: two integers, same sign, |n| <= 20
two integers, different signs, |n| <= 50
three integers, mixed signs, includes a zero pair
context: net change in altitude/fuel over several legs
skills.gen: T1: a,b same sign in [1,20]. T2: a in [-50,50], b opposite sign, |a| != |b|. T3: three terms, two of which sum to 0. T4: 3-4 signed changes in a story, answer the total.

errors.desc: keeps the sign of the first addend

skills.skin: climb/descend legs, fuel added vs burned, credits earned vs spent

skills.name: Adding rational numbers
skills.key: Apply the integer sign rules, then add like you already know: common denominators for fractions, line up the decimal points for decimals.
tiers: two decimals (1 place), mixed signs
two fractions, like denominators, mixed signs
two fractions, unlike denominators (2..12), mixed signs, may include mixed numbers
three rationals mixing fractions and decimals in a context
skills.gen: T1: decimals to 0.1, |x| < 20. T2: same denominator d in [3,12]. T3: denominators with lcm <= 60; mixed numbers up to 5. T4: convert to one form first; answer accepts fraction or decimal.

errors.desc: integer sign-rule error carried into rationals

skills.skin: fuel tank fractions, fuel-flow in decimal liters, altitude in tenths of a thousand feet

skills.name: Subtracting integers
skills.key: Subtracting a number is adding its opposite: a - b = a + (-b). Subtracting a negative moves you right.
tiers: positive minus positive, may go negative
subtract a negative (a - (-b))
negative minus negative, |n| <= 50
change = final - initial with signed values in a context; distance as |a - b|
skills.gen: T1: a in [0,30], b in [1,40]. T2: a in [-20,20], b in [-20,-1]. T3: both negative. T4: start/end altitude or temperature, ask the change (signed) or the distance (absolute).

errors.desc: negates the first number instead of the second

skills.skin: altitude change in a dive, temperature drop with altitude, before/after fuel

skills.name: Subtracting rational numbers
skills.key: Rewrite as adding the opposite, then use common denominators or aligned decimals. Distance on a number line is |a - b|.
tiers: decimals (1-2 places), one negative
fractions, like denominators, subtract a negative
fractions, unlike denominators, mixed numbers, both signs
distance between two rationals on a vertical number line (altitude/depth)
skills.gen: T1: decimals to 0.01, |x| < 25. T2: d in [3,12]. T3: lcm <= 60, mixed numbers to 5. T4: two signed rationals, answer |a - b| as a fraction or decimal.
skills.skin: altitude vs depth of a sub target, fuel margin below minimum, thermal readings

skills.name: Multiplying integers
skills.key: Multiply the sizes. Same signs give positive, different signs give negative. An even count of negatives is positive.
tiers: one negative factor, products <= 100
two negative factors, products <= 200
three factors with mixed signs
(-a)^2 vs -a^2 and rate x time contexts (descent rate x minutes)
skills.gen: T1: a in [-12,-2], b in [2,12]. T2: both in [-15,-2]. T3: three factors in [-9,9] excluding 0 and 1. T4: pair a power problem with a rate problem.

errors.desc: applies the addition sign rule (neg x neg = neg)
miscounts negatives in a product of three

skills.skin: descent rate x time = altitude lost, thrust settings, repeated fuel-burn legs

skills.name: Dividing integers
skills.key: Same sign rule as multiplication. -(p/q) = (-p)/q = p/(-q). You cannot divide by 0.
tiers: one negative, exact quotients <= 12
both negative, exact quotients
identify equivalent forms of -(p/q); quotient that is a fraction
negative rates: total change / time in a context
skills.gen: T1: q in [2,12], a = q*b with b in [-12,-1]. T2: both negative. T3: pick the expression NOT equal to -(p/q); or 7 / (-2) = -3.5. T4: altitude lost over minutes -> rate per minute.

errors.distractor: pick the equal form as unequal

skills.skin: average descent rate, fuel burn per minute from a total, splitting a negative credit balance

skills.name: Converting between fractions and decimals
skills.key: Divide numerator by denominator. The decimal terminates if the remainder hits 0, repeats if a remainder repeats (bar over the repeating digits).
tiers: terminating decimals (denominators 2, 4, 5, 8, 10, 20, 25)
repeating decimals (denominators 3, 6, 9, 11, 12)
decimal to fraction in simplest form; mixed numbers
choose terminating vs repeating without computing, from the denominator
skills.gen: T1/T2 pick denominator from the listed sets, numerator coprime. T3: decimal with 1-3 places -> reduce. T4: multiple choice on which fractions terminate.
skills.skin: fuel gauge fractions vs digital readout, Mach fraction to decimal

skills.name: Multiplying rational numbers
skills.key: Decide the sign first. Convert mixed numbers to improper fractions. Simplify, then multiply straight across.
tiers: signed decimal x integer
signed fraction x fraction, simple denominators
mixed numbers with signs
three factors mixing fractions and decimals in a context
skills.gen: T1: decimal to 0.1 x integer. T2: denominators 2..9. T3: mixed numbers to 4, one negative. T4: rate x fraction of time x count.

errors.desc: multiplies whole parts and fraction parts separately

skills.skin: fraction of a tank burned per leg, thrust as a fraction of max, scaled ordnance loads

skills.name: Dividing rational numbers and complex fractions
skills.key: Decide the sign. Keep the first fraction, change division to multiplication, flip the second fraction. A complex fraction is just a division problem.
tiers: signed decimal / integer
fraction / fraction with signs
mixed numbers; simplify a complex fraction like (1/2)/(3/4)
multi-step context combining division and another operation
skills.gen: T1: decimals to 0.1. T2: denominators 2..9. T3: mixed to 4; complex fraction from two fractions. T4: total / (fraction of time) etc.

errors.desc: flips the first fraction instead of the second

skills.skin: how many legs a fraction of a tank covers, splitting a fuel load across tanks, complex fraction as rate over rate
